name: IN/OUT: Breathing Timer
subtitle: Breathe for what's next
shortDescription: Guided breathing, custom patterns and private before-and-after check-ins.
description:
Make a little room for yourself with InOut. Choose a breathing rhythm, follow clear visual, audio and haptic guidance, and build a practice that fits your day.

All ten breathing protocols are included for free. Core practice, saved routines and history work offline without an account. Choose a personal goal, discover a recommended practice, and see your sessions, breathing time, streaks and achievements in one private place. Optional before-and-after check-ins help you notice how you feel. Share a milestone card when you choose.

InOut Pro offers unlimited saved patterns and mixes, private practice insights, up to five personal reminders and a practice without ads. Monthly and annual subscriptions are available through your app store. Prices and any eligible introductory offers appear before purchase. Restore purchases and manage your subscription from the app.

Available in English, Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese, with light and dark themes.

State Shift is self-reported, not biometric. Breathe comfortably and stop if dizzy, faint or unwell. InOut is not a medical device. High-intensity cyclic breathing requires a separate safety confirmation before each practice. Never practice while driving or in water.
